description: Sailors in dark navy uniforms and caps, and soldiers in pith helmets, crowd rowing boats and leap onto a stone quay under a massive old stone fortress with a cannon embrasure. Several steel warships with smoke-streaming funnels sit offshore, and a domed mosque with a slender minaret rises behind smoke and fire on the skyline. Choppy grey sea and a stormy sky frame the scene, and one sailor runs up the quay with a rifle. The painting is edge to edge, with no frame or visible border. A small word, possibly 'TORPEDO', appears on a cap ribbon at the lower right.
